reductions_and_simplifications.proposal: Add Android Maps Utils quadtree spatial clustering
reductions_and_simplifications.rationale: 179 markers are lightweight. Standard platform rendering avoids third-party dependency bloat and marker jitter.

reductions_and_simplifications.proposal: Apply custom desert/terracotta tile styling JSON
reductions_and_simplifications.rationale: Over-styling base maps damages road/water legibility and increases tile asset payload. Native system light/dark styling prioritized.

reductions_and_simplifications.proposal: Add Room/SwiftData tables to persist viewport and selected pins across restarts
reductions_and_simplifications.rationale: M11 strictly outlaws Room and SwiftData. In-memory ViewModel state suffices.

reductions_and_simplifications.proposal: Fetch and draw all 154 routes at once
reductions_and_simplifications.rationale: Drawing 154 routes causes extreme visual spaghetti. Geometry is requested on-demand only for the focused/selected corridor.

reductions_and_simplifications.proposal: Create abstract MapEntity base class with common interface
reductions_and_simplifications.rationale: Polymorphic dumping loses truth boundaries. Distinct Destination, TransitStop, RouteGeometry, and CivicService types preserve exact truth contracts.

reductions_and_simplifications.proposal: Continuously stream GPS fixes with background service
reductions_and_simplifications.rationale: Battery drain, privacy violation, and excessive permission friction. Use one-shot foreground fix when traveler taps 'My Location'.
